meta.churn: join ~ Bernoulli(lambda_in) per slot; leave ~ Bernoulli(lambda_out * n_active) per slot

policies.density_1_harmonic: round K down to a power of two, admit iff rounded density <= 1 (Prop. 1a + Cor. 2)
policies.admit_then_edf: admit while rho <= 1, rely on lazy EDF
policies.harmonic_residue_constructive: admit iff a free residue class exists on a 64-slot dyadic wheel (equivalent to the harmonic density test, but it also *constructs* the schedule); offsets of admitted cameras are never reassigned

meta.note: a violation episode = a camera whose window elapsed without service; the counter is reset after each episode so that one long outage is not counted many times
